confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Siem Reap tourist pricing for July 2026. No live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary widely by location and season. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation is the 15 October 2026 RBA rate; a 16 October figure was reported by third parties but not confirmed on the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian tourist towns with USD-influenced pricing and similar visitor mix, such as Luang Prabang and Phnom Penh, with Siem Reap's Pub Street and temple-tourism price levels as the reference.
